# ── 1. BIOMASS CONTRIBUTION BY PHASE ─────────────────────────
```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. LOAD & CLEAN DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_df <- read.csv("Ess_data/ESS (cleaned) q-adj data for 1970-2022.csv") |> ## Q corrected
#long_df <- read.csv("Ess_data/ESS(cleaned)not-q-adj data for 1970-2022.csv") |> ## Not Q corrected
  filter(SPECIES < 1000, YEAR >= 1970, YEAR <= 2022) |>
  filter(!is.na(SPECIES_NAME), SPECIES_NAME != "NA",
         !grepl("INCL |snail|unidentified|GADOIDEI|unid\\.|S\\.O\\.",
                SPECIES_NAME, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  filter(!SPECIES_NAME %in% c(
    "INCL SHARK & CHONDRICHTHYES; SHARK",
    "SAND LANCES", "SKATES", "EELPOUTS")) |>
  rename(Year = YEAR, Species = SPECIES_NAME)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. COMMUNITY MATRIX
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_wide <- long_df |>
  group_by(Year, Species) |>
  summarise(Biomass = sum(BIOMASS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Biomass, values_fill = 0)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. PRE/POST MORATORIUM PHASE DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_df_phase <- long_wide |>
  filter(between(Year, 1978, 2022)) |>
  mutate(Phase = factor(if_else(Year <= 1992,
  "1978-1992 (Reference Period)", "1993-2022 (Unconstrained Period)"),
  levels = c("1978-1992 (Reference Period)","1993-2022 (Unconstrained Period)"))) |>
  pivot_longer(-c(Year, Phase), names_to = "Species", values_to = "BIOMASS") |>
  filter(!is.na(BIOMASS), BIOMASS > 0) |>
  group_by(Species) |> filter(n() >= 5) |> ungroup()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. PHASE PERCENTAGE SUMMARY
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
phase_pct <- long_df_phase |>
  group_by(Phase, Species) |>
  summarise(BIOMASS = sum(BIOMASS), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(Phase) |>
  mutate(Pct = BIOMASS / sum(BIOMASS)) |>
  ungroup()

phase_pct <- phase_pct |>
  arrange(Phase, desc(Pct)) |>
  group_by(Phase) |>
  mutate(Rank   = row_number(),   CumPct = cumsum(Pct)) |>
  filter(is.finite(Pct)) |>
  mutate(Species = str_to_sentence(str_squish(str_replace_all(Species, "\\.+", " ")))) |>
  ungroup()

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. COLOUR PALETTE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
pal <- c("1978-1992 (Reference Period)"    = "#E07B2A",
         "1993-2022 (Unconstrained Period)" = "#2471A3")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. PLOT FUNCTION
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
make_phase_plot <- function(ph, df = phase_pct) {
  col      <- pal[[ph]]
  cut_rank <- df |> filter(Phase == ph) |>
  summarise(cut = min(Rank[CumPct >= 0.95])) |>
  pull(cut)

  df_ph <- df |>filter(Phase == ph) |>
    mutate(Species = factor(Species, levels = rev(unique(Species))),
    Above95 = Rank <= cut_rank)
  ypos <- as.numeric(df_ph$Species[df_ph$Rank == cut_rank][1]) - 0.5
  ggplot(df_ph, aes(Pct, Species)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf,ymin = ypos,  ymax = Inf,fill = col, alpha = 0.06) +
    geom_col(aes(alpha = Above95), fill = col, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.95) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.85, "FALSE" = 0.45),guide = "none") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = ypos,colour = col, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
    annotate("label",  x = Inf, y = ypos,
             label = "95% cumulative biomass",
             colour = col, fill = "white", label.size = 0,
             hjust = 1.0, vjust = -0.2, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))) +
    labs(title = ph, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      panel.border       = element_rect(colour = col, fill = NA, linewidth = 1.2),
      plot.background    = element_rect(colour = col, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4),
      plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, colour = col,
                                        margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey20"),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7,   colour = "grey40"),
      axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line          = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      plot.margin        = margin(10, 14, 10, 10))
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 8. ASSEMBLE PLOT
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
p <- make_phase_plot("1978-1992 (Reference Period)") +
  make_phase_plot("1993-2022 (Unconstrained Period)") +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12,family = "serif", hjust = 0.6,
                                     margin = margin(b = 5)),
      plot.subtitle   = element_text(colour = "grey40", size = 9,
                                     family = "serif", margin = margin(b = 10)),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    ))

p
ggsave("Ess_Output/Species_contribution_Q.tiff", plot = p,width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600, compression = "lzw")
#ggsave("Ess_Output/Species_contribution_no_Q.tiff", plot = p,width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600,compression = "lzw")

```


# CLUSTER_PLOT
# 2. DATA LOADING
```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. LOAD & CLEAN DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
filename <- "Ess_data/ESS (cleaned) q-adj data for 1970-2022.csv" # Qcorrected
#filename <- "Ess_data/ESS(cleaned)not-q-adj data for 1970-2022.csv" # not Qcorrected
long_df <- read.csv(filename, header = TRUE) |>
  filter(SPECIES < 1000, YEAR >= 1970, YEAR <= 2022) |>
  filter(YEAR != 2018) |>    
  filter(YEAR != 2022) |> # ← remove incomplete year
  filter(!is.na(SPECIES_NAME), SPECIES_NAME != "NA",
         !grepl("INCL |snail|unidentified|GADOIDEI|unid\\.|S\\.O\\.",
                SPECIES_NAME, ignore.case = TRUE)) |>
  filter(!SPECIES_NAME %in% c(
    "INCL SHARK & CHONDRICHTHYES; SHARK",
    "SAND LANCES", "SKATES", "EELPOUTS")) |>
  rename(Year = YEAR, Species = SPECIES_NAME)

# Two survey years were excluded prior to analysis: 2018, which recorded anomalously few species (n = 27; long-term mean = 62 ± 9), consistent with incomplete sampling rather than a true ecological signal; and 2022, which fell below the minimum species richness threshold applied to ensure comparability across years (n ≥ 45 species per year). 
## Outlier
#"Years 2018 and 2022 were excluded from all analyses. The 2018 survey was omitted due to documented data irregularities that rendered biomass estimates non-comparable with adjacent years. The 2022 data were excluded as catchability-adjusted estimates for the terminal year had not been finalised at the time of analysis."

```

Cluster Plot:Cluster Plot: K-MEANS CLUSTERING ON PC1–PC2 ─────────────────────────
```{r}
## ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. COMMUNITY MATRIX
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
long_wide <- long_df |>
  group_by(Year, Species) |>
  summarise(Biomass = sum(BIOMASS, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = Biomass, values_fill = 0)

write.csv(long_wide, "Ess_data/PCA.csv", row.names = FALSE)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. PREPARE MATRIX
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
years   <- long_wide$Year                                  # ← saved before removing
pl.data <- long_wide |> select(-Year)
pl.data <- as.data.frame(lapply(pl.data, as.numeric))
rownames(pl.data) <- years


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. REMOVE SPECIES PRESENT IN FEWER THAN 2 YEARS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
presence     <- colSums(pl.data > 0)
keep_species <- names(presence[presence >= 2])             # ← was >= 1
pl.data      <- pl.data[, keep_species]

cat("Species kept (>=3 years):", ncol(pl.data), "\n")
cat("Species removed:         ", length(presence) - ncol(pl.data), "\n")
cat("Years included:          ", nrow(pl.data), "\n")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. PCA  ← log-transform
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
pl.data.log <- log1p(pl.data)                              # ← log-transform
res.pca     <- prcomp(pl.data.log, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
PoV         <- res.pca$sdev^2 / sum(res.pca$sdev^2)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. PCA SCORES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
pca_2d  <- res.pca$x[, 1:2]
scores  <- as.data.frame(res.pca$x)         # rebuild from scratch
scores$Year <- rownames(scores)             # rownames are already the years

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 8. hierarchical clustering ON PC1-PC2....method 2
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
d  <- dist(pca_2d, method = "euclidean")
hc <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
scores$Cluster <- factor(cutree(hc, k = 2))
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 9. CLUSTER PLOT
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
cluster_colours <- c("1" = "#2166AC", "2" = "#D6604D")

p <- ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = Cluster), geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.10,
               linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Year), size = 3, max.overlaps = 50,
                  segment.colour = "grey60") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colours) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = cluster_colours) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "right",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text        = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.border     = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.background  = element_blank()) +
  labs(
    x     = paste0("PC1 (", round(PoV[1] * 100, 1), "% variance)"),
    y     = paste0("PC2 (", round(PoV[2] * 100, 1), "% variance)"),
    color = "Cluster",
    fill  = "Cluster")

p

ggsave("Ess_Output/CLUSTER_PLOT.jpeg", plot = p, width = 8, height = 6,
       dpi = 600)
```

# CHANGEPOINT ANALYSIS 
```{r}
# ── CHANGEPOINT ANALYSIS ─────────────────────────────────────
library(trend)
library(segmented)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Build year_scores from prcomp output
year_scores <- as.data.frame(res.pca$x[, 1:2])
colnames(year_scores) <- c("Dim.1", "Dim.2")
year_scores$Year <- as.integer(rownames(year_scores))

# ── PC1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pettitt.test(year_scores$Dim.1)
mk.test(ts(year_scores$Dim.1, start = 1970))

df_clean <- year_scores |>
  dplyr::filter(Year != 2018) |>
  dplyr::select(year = Year, dim1 = Dim.1)

# Single breakpoint only — 1977 is robust; second break is initialisation-sensitive
seg_fit2 <- segmented(
  lm(dim1 ~ year, data = df_clean),
  seg.Z = ~year,
  psi = 1977
)
summary(seg_fit2)
confint(seg_fit2)

df_clean$fitted1 <- fitted(seg_fit2)
bp1 <- confint(seg_fit2)
pettitt_k1 <- 1970 + 25 - 1  # K=25 → 1994

# ── PC2 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pettitt.test(year_scores$Dim.2)
mk.test(ts(year_scores$Dim.2, start = 1970))

df2_clean <- year_scores |>
  dplyr::filter(Year != 2018) |>
  dplyr::select(year = Year, dim2 = Dim.2)

# Two breakpoints for PC2 — both stable across initialisations
seg_fit3 <- segmented(
  lm(dim2 ~ year, data = df2_clean),
  seg.Z = ~year,
  psi = c(1996, 2017))
summary(seg_fit3)
confint(seg_fit3)

df2_clean$fitted2 <- fitted(seg_fit3)
bp2 <- confint(seg_fit3)
pettitt_k2 <- 1970 + 11 - 1  # K=11 → 1980

# ── PLOT PC1 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
p1 <- ggplot(df_clean, aes(x = year, y = dim1)) +

  # Pettitt changepoint band
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = pettitt_k1 - 0.5, xmax = pettitt_k1 + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#639922", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("text",
           x = pettitt_k1, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("Pettitt\n", pettitt_k1),
           vjust = 1.3, size = 2.8, colour = "#3B6D11",
           fontface = "italic", family = "serif") +

  # Single breakpoint CI shading
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = bp1["psi1.year", "CI(95%).low"],
           xmax = bp1["psi1.year", "CI(95%).up"],
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#D85A30", alpha = 0.10) +

  # Single breakpoint vertical line
  geom_vline(xintercept = bp1["psi1.year", "Est."],
             colour = "#D85A30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # Breakpoint label
  annotate("text",
           x = bp1["psi1.year", "Est."], y = Inf,
           label = paste0(round(bp1["psi1.year", "Est."])),
           vjust = 1.4, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8,
           colour = "#993C1D", fontface = "bold", family = "serif") +

  # Raw scores
  geom_point(colour = "#378ADD", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +

  # Segmented trend line
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted1),
            colour = "#D85A30", linewidth = 1.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1970, 2021, by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Dimension 1 (PC1)",
    subtitle = paste0("Mann-Kendall \u03c4 = 0.86, p < 0.001  |  ",
                      "Pettitt p < 0.001 (K = 25 \u2192 1994)  |  ",
                      "Breakpoint: ", round(bp1["psi1.year", "Est."]),
                      " (95% CI: ", round(bp1["psi1.year", "CI(95%).low"]),
                      "\u2013", round(bp1["psi1.year", "CI(95%).up"]), ")"),
    x = NULL,
    y = "PC1 score"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, colour = "#185FA5"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    panel.border  = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line     = element_blank()
  )

# ── PLOT PC2 ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
p2 <- ggplot(df2_clean, aes(x = year, y = dim2)) +

  # Pettitt changepoint band
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = pettitt_k2 - 0.5, xmax = pettitt_k2 + 0.5,
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#639922", alpha = 0.15) +
  annotate("text",
           x = pettitt_k2, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("Pettitt\n", pettitt_k2),
           vjust = 1.3, size = 2.8, colour = "#3B6D11",
           fontface = "italic", family = "serif") +

  # Breakpoint CI shading — psi1
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = bp2["psi1.year", "CI(95%).low"],
           xmax = bp2["psi1.year", "CI(95%).up"],
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#D85A30", alpha = 0.10) +

  # Breakpoint CI shading — psi2
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = bp2["psi2.year", "CI(95%).low"],
           xmax = bp2["psi2.year", "CI(95%).up"],
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#D85A30", alpha = 0.10) +

  # Breakpoint vertical lines
  geom_vline(xintercept = bp2["psi1.year", "Est."],
             colour = "#D85A30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = bp2["psi2.year", "Est."],
             colour = "#D85A30", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +

  # Breakpoint labels
  annotate("text",
           x = bp2["psi1.year", "Est."], y = Inf,
           label = paste0(round(bp2["psi1.year", "Est."])),
           vjust = 1.4, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8,
           colour = "#993C1D", fontface = "bold", family = "serif") +
  annotate("text",
           x = bp2["psi2.year", "Est."], y = Inf,
           label = paste0(round(bp2["psi2.year", "Est."])),
           vjust = 1.4, hjust = -0.15, size = 2.8,
           colour = "#993C1D", fontface = "bold", family = "serif") +

  # Raw scores
  geom_point(colour = "#1D9E75", size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +

  # Segmented trend line
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted2),
            colour = "#D85A30", linewidth = 1.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1970, 2021, by = 5)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Dimension 2 (PC2)",
    subtitle = paste0("Mann-Kendall \u03c4 = \u22120.06, p = 0.525  |  ",
                      "Pettitt p = 0.019 (K = 11 \u2192 1980)  |  ",
                      "Breakpoints: ", round(bp2["psi1.year", "Est."]),
                      " & ", round(bp2["psi2.year", "Est."])),
    x        = "Year",
    y        = "PC2 score"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, colour = "#0F6E56"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    panel.border  = element_rect(colour = "grey70", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.line     = element_blank()
  )

# ── COMBINE AND SAVE ─────────────────────────────────────────
p_combined <- p1 / p2 +
  plot_annotation(
    caption = paste0(
      "Dashed lines = segmented regression breakpoints; ",
      "orange shading = 95% CI; green band = Pettitt changepoint.\n",
      "PC1: single breakpoint model (second breakpoint initialisation-sensitive). ",
      "PC2: two-breakpoint model (both stable across initialisations)." ),
    theme = theme(
      plot.caption    = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey50",
                                     family = "serif", hjust = 0),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
  )

p_combined


# To evaluate this directly, we used the first two dimensions of our PCA to assess whether there was a detectable change in community composition over time. Dimension 1, which captured the dominant axis of compositional change, exhibited a strong positive monotonic trend across the full 50-year series (Mann-Kendall τ = 0.86, p < 0.001), with Pettitt's test identifying 1994 as the point of maximum cumulative contrast between early and late community states (U* = 625, p < 0.001). Segmented regression resolved the underlying dynamic more precisely, detecting a single robust structural breakpoint at 1977 (95% CI: 1973–1980), marking the onset of a sustained directional shift in community composition that continued through the remainder of the time series. Dimension 2 showed no significant monotonic trend (Mann-Kendall τ = −0.06, p = 0.525), indicating that change along this axis was non-directional; nevertheless, Pettitt's test detected a significant changepoint at 1980 (U* = 315, p = 0.019), and segmented regression identified two structural breaks at 1996 (95% CI: 1994–1999) and 2017 (95% CI: 2013–2020), reflecting episodic reorganisation rather than a sustained trajectory. Together, these results indicate that the compositional shift along the dominant community axis was first detectable in 1977, predating the 1992 moratorium by approximately 15 years, and that a secondary axis of non-directional restructuring continued to operate well into the 2000s and 2010s.

```


## Ranked Biomass Contribution Through Time
```{r}
###################################################################################
# 1. LIBRARIES
###################################################################################
library(dplyr)
library(data.table)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

filename <- "Ess_data/PCA.csv"
pl.data  <- read.csv(filename, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

# Set row names from first column (Year)
rownames(pl.data) <- pl.data[, 1]

# Remove Year column
SP_as_colA <- pl.data |> dplyr::select(-1)

# Ensure numeric and restore row names
SP_as_colA           <- as.data.frame(lapply(SP_as_colA, as.numeric))
rownames(SP_as_colA) <- rownames(pl.data)

# Transpose: species as rows, years as columns
Yr_as_col             <- t(as.matrix(SP_as_colA))
Yr_as_col[is.na(Yr_as_col)] <- 0

###################################################################################
# 4. FILTER RARE SPECIES (present in >= 5 years)
###################################################################################
keep      <- rowSums(Yr_as_col > 0) >= 5
Yr_as_col <- Yr_as_col[keep, ]
cat("Species retained after filtering:", nrow(Yr_as_col), "\n")

###################################################################################
# 5. RANK BIOMASS WITHIN EACH SPECIES (row-wise)
###################################################################################
drRanked <- t(apply(Yr_as_col, 1, function(i) {
  data.table::frank(i, ties.method = "dense")
}))
drRanked           <- as.data.frame(drRanked)
colnames(drRanked) <- colnames(Yr_as_col)
rownames(drRanked) <- rownames(Yr_as_col)

###################################################################################
# 6. COLOUR PALETTE
###################################################################################
heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(
  c("#2C7BB6", "#ABD9E9", "#FFFFBF", "#FDAE61", "#D7191C")
)(100)

###################################################################################
# 7. SAVE HEATMAP AS TIFF
###################################################################################
tiff("Ess_Output/heatmap.tiff", width = 22, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
pheatmap(
  drRanked,
  cluster_rows  = FALSE,
  cluster_cols  = FALSE,
  fontsize_row  = 5,
  fontsize_col  = 7,
  cellwidth     = 16,
  color         = heatmap_colors,
  xlab          = "Year",
  border_color  = NA
)
dev.off()

###################################################################################
# 8. DISPLAY HEATMAP IN VIEWER
###################################################################################
pheatmap(
  drRanked,
  cluster_rows  = FALSE,
  cluster_cols  = FALSE,
  fontsize_row  = 5,
  fontsize_col  = 7,
  cellwidth     = 16,
  color         = heatmap_colors,
  xlab          = "Year",
  border_color  = NA,
  main          = "Ranked Biomass Contribution Through Time"
)
```


#Heatmap of contribution to biomass of all species that contribut 95% and above
# Species that together account for 95% of the total biomass across all years.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. LOAD DATA
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
#pl.data <- read.csv(filename)
rownames(pl.data) <- pl.data$Year
pl.data <- pl.data %>% select(-Year)
pl.data[is.na(pl.data)] <- 0

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. RELATIVE BIOMASS (within each year)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
rel_biomass <- sweep(pl.data, 1, rowSums(pl.data), FUN = "/")
rel_biomass[is.na(rel_biomass)] <- 0

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. MEAN CONTRIBUTION ACROSS YEARS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
mean_contrib <- colMeans(rel_biomass)
mean_contrib <- sort(mean_contrib, decreasing = TRUE)
cum_contrib  <- cumsum(mean_contrib)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. SELECT SPECIES (top 95% of biomass)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
threshold    <- 0.95
keep_species <- names(cum_contrib[cum_contrib <= threshold])
keep_species <- unique(c(
  keep_species,
  names(cum_contrib)[which(cum_contrib > threshold)[1]]
))
mat_filtered <- rel_biomass[, keep_species, drop = FALSE]
mat_filtered <- mat_filtered[, order(colMeans(mat_filtered), decreasing = TRUE)]

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. ENSURE YEAR ORDER (1978 → 2022)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
mat_filtered <- mat_filtered[order(as.numeric(rownames(mat_filtered))), ]

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. TRANSPOSE & FIX COLUMN ORDER
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
mat_t <- t(mat_filtered)

# Prefix year colnames so pheatmap treats them as strings not numbers
colnames(mat_t) <- paste0("y", colnames(mat_t))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. HEATMAP
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
library(ggplotify)

p <- as.ggplot(pheatmap(
  mat_t,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  scale = "none",
  fontsize_row = 7,
  fontsize_col = 6,
  angle_col = 90,
  border_color = NA,
  cellwidth = 11,
  cellheight = 11,
  labels_col = gsub("y", "", colnames(mat_t)),
  color = colorRampPalette(c("#2C7BB6","#ABD9E9","#FFFFBF","#FDAE61","#D7191C"))(100),
  silent = TRUE
))
p
ggsave("heatmap.png",
       plot = p,
       width = 13,
       height = 5,
       units = "in",
       dpi = 1000,
       limitsize = FALSE)
#  Species that together account for 95% of the total biomass across all years.

# The PCA was conducted using annual fish species biomass as variables, where each species represented one variable and each year (1978–2022) was an observation.

```


PHASE PERCENTAGE SUMMARY — FULL PERIOD
```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# PHASE PERCENTAGE SUMMARY — FULL PERIOD
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
phase_pct <- long_wide |>
  filter(between(Year, 1978, 2022)) |>
  pivot_longer(-Year, names_to = "Species", values_to = "BIOMASS") |>
  filter(!is.na(BIOMASS), BIOMASS > 0) |>
  group_by(Species) |> filter(n() >= 5) |> ungroup() |>
  group_by(Species) |>
  summarise(BIOMASS = sum(BIOMASS), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Pct = BIOMASS / sum(BIOMASS)) |>
  arrange(desc(Pct)) |>
  mutate(
    Rank    = row_number(),
    CumPct  = cumsum(Pct),
    Species = str_to_sentence(str_squish(str_replace_all(Species, "\\.+", " ")))
  ) |>
  filter(is.finite(Pct))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# PLOT — SINGLE PANEL
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
col      <- "#2C7873"   # single colour of your choice
cut_rank <- phase_pct |>
  summarise(cut = min(Rank[CumPct >= 0.95])) |>
  pull(cut)

df_ph <- phase_pct |>
  mutate(
    Species  = factor(Species, levels = rev(unique(Species))),
    Above95  = Rank <= cut_rank
  )

ypos <- as.numeric(df_ph$Species[df_ph$Rank == cut_rank][1]) - 0.5

p <- ggplot(df_ph, aes(Pct, Species)) +
  annotate("rect",
           xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ypos, ymax = Inf,
           fill = col, alpha = 0.06) +
  geom_col(aes(alpha = Above95),
           fill = col, colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2, width = 0.95) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("TRUE" = 0.85, "FALSE" = 0.45), guide = "none") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = ypos,
             colour = col, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("label",
           x = Inf, y = ypos,
           label = "95% cumulative biomass",
           colour = col, fill = "white", label.size = 0,
           hjust = 1.0, vjust = -0.2, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.28))
  ) +
  labs(
    title    = "Full Reference Period: 1978–2022",
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    panel.border       = element_rect(colour = col, fill = NA, linewidth = 1.2),
    plot.background    = element_rect(colour = col, fill = "white", linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, colour = col,
                                      margin = margin(b = 6)),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 7.5, colour = "grey20"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 7,   colour = "grey40"),
    axis.ticks         = element_line(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line          = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    plot.margin        = margin(10, 14, 10, 10)
  )

p
```
